scores.feedback: Right shape: one question followed through the app, and the Blender pieces mark real events (the cast, the character). But 90 s is too long for a short, 170 words can't be burned-in text, a job question followed by a reading looks like the app hands you the answer, and the 'Go deeper' montage is a feature list in the slot where the judgment idea should go. It also assumes a random cast lands on a hexagram with a character clip. To reach 8+: ~50 s vertical; ~60 words of text, cards of 3-8 words; state the idea as 'The I Ching is not a yes-or-no answer. / It is practice in judgment.'; replace the montage with Wang Bi commentary and 'What would prove this wrong' (the key beat), end on the Journal; use 18 蠱, whose hexagram, character and end card clips all exist at 82.5 bpm; get the 18 reading from a real saved reading or --screenshot-reading-18-18.

A complete, carefully worded feature tour, but 16:9 with the phone in the middle is not a short, 2 min and 280 words become slides without a voice, the per-chapter neon lines are decoration and need new Blender work, and six chapters is the plan most likely to stall. It says what is in the app, not why it is different. It only reaches 8+ by becoming revised Plan A. Keep a long 16:9 tour for the site or YouTube for later; the site tour's stills already cover it.

Most fun and easiest to finish, and the character does real teaching work, but it is nearly the existing character specials (which already have hook, lesson, plates, end card and an empty screens slot). A newcomer never sees a question asked or a reading arrive, the hexagram-to-feature pairings are puns, the judgment idea is absent, and it is three videos when the goal is to finish one. To reach 8+: make one, add the missing middle (ask, reading, Wang Bi, 'What would prove this wrong', Journal), which makes it revised Plan A with C's look. Later, fill the screens slot of future character specials with 4-6 s of the matching app reading.

recommended: One vertical short, ~52 s at 82.5 bpm, on 18 蠱 Work on the Decayed (hexagram, character and join end card clips already rendered at that tempo; music from the character-18 special). Spine: judgment, not a yes-or-no answer, said in the site's 'X is not ... It is ...' form without banned words. Shots: (1) code rain, typed question 'Fix the old project, / or start over?' (2-3) 'The I Ching is not / a yes-or-no answer.' 'It is practice / in judgment.' (4) live Ask screen, Matrix look, coins tossed: 'Ask a real question.' (5) Blender hexagram lines: 'Six lines. / One of 64 situations.' (6) Blender 蠱 character with the approved lesson 'Found rot? / Clean it out.' (7-8) live reading, Wang Bi opens: 'Decay is not the end. / It is work to do.' 'Read the Confucian way: / Ten Wings, Wang Bi.' (9, key beat) live Gua 'what would prove this wrong': 'Every reading says / what would prove it wrong.' (10) live Journal: 'You decide. / Write down what happened.' (11) Blender end card: 'Six lines reveal the moment. / sixlines.day'. ~60 words on screen, ~20 s of new simulator recording in one session, everything else reused. Post to Reels, Shorts and TikTok with the Records shorts, pin on the site; a 30 s live-only cut can serve as the App Store preview. Never show the 'not fortune-telling' lines: they contain a banned word.
